summary: The self-observation log reader now probes the signed log total and fetches the explicit tail range, so terminal failure annotations in long repair-cell logs are included in the bounded read; the added tests cover redirect and inline responses, range-ignoring hosts, short logs, exact byte boundaries and malformed partial responses. This directly addresses the no-allowlisted-pattern symptom with a reproducing long-log regression test, and the fail-closed content-range checks keep the read bounded and credential-free.

evidence: ops/hosted-autonomy-github.ts:780-806 sends a bytes=0-0 probe to the signed log URL, derives the byte total, then requests the explicit tail range so the terminal Process completed with exit code line of a log larger than SELF_DEFECT_MAX_LOG_BYTES is included in the bounded read.

tests/host/hosted-autonomy-self-log_test.ts:15-109 runs the production readJobLog through runSelfObservationPass over a roughly 690KB synthetic repair_cell log and asserts the filed issue carries the repair_cell exit:1 signature instead of the no-allowlisted-pattern class.

The base only read the first maxBytes from the head of a redirected log, which is the mechanism that could file the generic no-allowlisted-pattern observation for a long repair-cell log; the candidate adds the explicit-range tail read documented in src/github/client-ci-evidence-log.ts.
